title: Modern Horizons 1 Timeshifts: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: The best presents are impossible to regift.
She provides marks of protection to those she chooses as family.
"Glorious, to walk again across the savannah with my beloved." —"Love Song of Night and Day"
"The patterns of crossing ripples reveal the future to those who know how to read them."
A mercurial face sows distrust. Distrust reaps a lonely life.
The only shortcut in a bog is to the bottom.
"The lasting effects are invariably fatal." —Phyrexian progress notes
"To see past the veil of death, cross it." —*The Red Book of Mezdrithalik*
Opening like the maw of a hellion, the earth swallowed the traveler whole.
Pricey baubles are no match for cheap tricks.
Born from the oldest red cedar, nursed on the sap of the tallest spruce, coronated under the mightiest pine.
The vines overgrew the construct, snapping gears and soaking up aether.
"Llanowar remembers the Ice Age, the Phyrexian Invasion, and the Rift Era. So long as we draw breath, we will ensure such disasters never threaten our world again."
"Quell your ego and anywhere can be as calm as a hurricane's eye."
Warm enough to incubate eggs or incinerate those who would eat them.
"The sun banishes darkness every morning. I too will rise with such assuredness." —Huatli
"Good ideas don't take time. They take a lot of bad ideas first." —Ral Zarek
"The pain of exploring is less than the pain of not knowing." —Tamiyo
"You'll never get to the top if you don't know who's already there." —Kaya
"The continual rise of the downtrodden is as inevitable as vines usurping a forest." —Vraska
"Within minutes, the strange device was indistinguishable from the other upon my workbench." —Tocasia, journal entry
The stronghold of Theros's light.
There is beauty in the uncertainty of potential.
